arguments.message:
Yes! You can set up a recurring export that automatically drops the files into your cloud storage.

1. Go to **Settings → Data → Scheduled exports**.
2. Choose the ticket data you want to export and set the recurrence (daily, weekly, or monthly).
3. Connect your cloud‑storage destination (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.) via the OAuth connection – you only need to do this once per destination.
4. Save the schedule.

Each run will create a new file in the connected destination, and you can view the run history and status from the scheduled exports screen. This way you won’t need to export and upload manually every week.
